gameDescriptionHtml:
Welcome to a world in ruins, where humanity is on the brink of extinction and the undead roam hungry for human flesh. In “Dead War: Extreme Survival”, you are the last hope of the human race in the midst of chaos. Get ready for an intense, action-packed first-person experience where your shooting and strategy skills will be tested to the maximum.

The game takes place in a post-apocalyptic world devastated by a zombie outbreak. The player can explore abandoned urban environments, dark forests, and desolate rural areas.

The main objective is to survive as long as possible, facing zombies and other dangers while searching for supplies, weapons and refuge.

Game Features

  • Immersion: Detailed environments and realistic sounds contribute to a tense and immersive experience
  • Zombie Hordes: Zombies can vary in terms of speed, strength and resistance. Encounters can be stealthy or result in intense battles.
  • Health System: The player must monitor their health and treat wounds or illnesses to avoid becoming a zombie.
